title: External prior-art intake: logos lineara.xyz lineage defects D5 and D6

external_source.independence_note: The observations are external to JANUS but concern the same public lineara.xyz lineage; they are not an independent alternate-editorial transcription source.

contamination_rule.allowed_JANUS_action: Conformance replay, localization, generic-substrate hardening, sensitivity analysis and disagreement registration are allowed only when labelled as externally seeded tests.
contamination_rule.forbidden_action: Do not later describe D5 or D6 as independently discovered by JANUS.

defects.mechanism: A source sign-group continuing across faces/lines can be emitted by the lineara.xyz transliteratedWords layer as two independent word tokens.

known_cases.external_interpretation: continuation across faces; two emitted tokens belong to one source sign-group

required_generic_IR_response.semantic_claim: NONE; this is source-group continuity representation, not universal linguistic wordhood

defects.mechanism: The transliteration label *904 is reported for glyph U+1066B / LINEAR A SIGN A319, allowing an ontology built from labels to misclassify A319 as a fraction and omit the A319 identity.

requirements: freeze exact mwenge source commit before replay
freeze expected document identities and externally reported failure modes before execution
test generic detection rather than hard-code only the four document IDs
report both sensitivity on the seeded cases and any additional candidates separately
additional candidates discovered by a rule designed after seeing D5/D6 remain contamination-sensitive until independently validated
